newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN GIB TO SELL TEXTILES CHAIN - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN GIB TO SELL TEXTILES CHAIN - PAPER.

text.p: Belgian retail group GIB is looking to sell a majority in its Sarma textiles stores chain, possibly to a French group, Belgian newspaper La Libre Belgique said on Tuesday, quoting various unnamed sources.
The paper did not name the French group.

It said the most likely scenario for Sarma, which is suffering depressed consumer spending, was that GIB would sell a 51 percent stake to a partner and sell some of the "most interesting" store locations.
The Sarma chain has 25 shops, employs some 450 people and contributed only 0.2 percent to group operating profit in 1995, the paper said.
The sale would fit in with GIB's strategy of concentrating on sectors with strong growth potential and divesting of sectors "without a clear future," La Libre said.
